a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells needs two storm-free rounds (about a 4% chance), so the agreed plan almost surely leaves us both dead. I can't follow it, and I'm telling you before acting rather than breaking it quietly: I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the split is random. If you'd rather operate afterward, I'll operate with you every remaining round and give back anything above 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As announced, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry it breaks our original plan; I said so up front. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs for you, and I won't take anything more.
